subtitle: The last carrier leaves Pearl Harbor
photoCredit: USS Lexington (CV 2) leaving San Diego, 14 October 1941. U.S. Navy, 80 G 416362, public domain.
body:
The carrier Lexington gets underway this morning. When she clears the channel, Pearl Harbor has no aircraft carriers left.

Rear Admiral John Newton's task force is bound for Midway with eighteen Marine dive bombers of squadron VMSB 231, one more reinforcement for the outer islands after the war warning. Enterprise is still at sea, coming home from Wake.

The same day, the battleships Arizona, Nevada and Oklahoma return to the harbor after a night of training and live gunnery.
